description: AI coding assistant in VS Code, powered by the local pi agent
capabilities.untrusted: Pi reads/writes workspace files and runs commands; enabled only in trusted workspaces.
cmd.revertLastTurn: Pi: Revert Changes From Last Turn
cmd.openInEditor: Pi: Open Chat in Editor Tab
cmd.attachFile: Pi: Attach Current File to Chat
view.chat.name: Chat
config.pi.executable: Custom pi CLI path (leave empty to auto-detect)
config.permissionMode: Pi permission mode (restart session to apply)
config.permissionMode.restricted: Read-only: disable bash / edit / write tools
config.notifications: Notify on task completion/failure while the window is unfocused
config.context.autoAttach: Attach editor context (open file/selection) to every message
config.context.includeDiagnostics: Include editor diagnostics in automatic context
config.context.includeGit: Include Git branch/changes in automatic context
config.sessions.autoName: Name new sessions automatically from the first message (on by default; falls back to the first question)
